cases.out:
accountcreate - Creates a new account.
Usage: accountcreate username password (accesslevel)
accesslevel can be a number or enum name
0 = Player | 1 = Advocate | 2 = Sentinel | 3 = Envoy | 4 = Developer | 5 = Admin

testlootgen - Generates Loot for testing LootFactories.  Do testlootgen -info for examples.
Usage: testlootgen <number of items> <loot tier> <melee, missile, caster, armor, pet, aetheria (optional)>

verify-xp - Verifies and optionally fixes any bugs with player xp
Usage: verify-xp

deletecharacter - Deletes a character and removes it from players restore list
Usage: deletecharacter [character name]
Given the name of a character, this command deletes that character, booting it if in game, and removes it from character's restore list.  (You can find the name for a character using the @finger command.)
